evidence.reason: After edit, body calls metering.reset() and metering.evaluate(0, 0.1, "monthly") — the units parameter is no longer passed, so the function no longer computes a charge based on its input.
After edit, adds `if (units === 0) return 0;` and introduces `if (u< 0)` which references an undefined identifier `u` and is a syntax error, breaking module load.
Test asserts `await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0`; with units dropped and evaluate(0,...) returning 0, this assertion fails.
subscriptionCharge value-references chargeUnit, which is value-referenced by usageCharge; the broken usageCharge body prevents chargeUnit from being usable in the subscription path.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改共同破坏了订阅计费：subscriptionCharge 不再把 units 传给计量函数，且 usageCharge 引入了未定义变量 u 的语法错误，导致测试断言 subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 失败。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge，恢复将 units 传入 metering.evaluate（如 metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly")）并保留 metering.initialize()；同时修改 src/metering.ts#usageCharge，将 `if (u< 0)` 修正为 `if (units < 0)`。
